title: Sort the Vocabulary: Prefix-Ordered Token Classes Make Two-Level Language-Model Heads Cheap and Faithful — code and experimental results
description: Research code, reproducible experiment scripts, raw results, and the preprint on prefix-ordered token classes for two-level language-model output heads. The study compares grouping criteria in five frozen open language models and models trained from scratch, with end-to-end CPU and head-only GPU cost measurements. Likelihood and KL results are limited to the text domains described in the paper; downstream tasks and speculative-decoding acceptance were not evaluated. The variations study includes a word-start/continuation hybrid, reversed-spelling controls, three-level trees, block-size sweeps, and a failed refinement heuristic.
